title: Gemini 4 Argon: Can AI Build a Dashboard? The ₹50 Mistake
description:
Google released Gemini 4 Argon on October 13, 2026. It's designed for complex reasoning, coding and multi-step workflows. But can a beautifully generated dashboard still be wrong? In this practical explainer, we walk through an ORIGINAL FICTIONAL shop-sales example: sales of ₹120, ₹95 and ₹110, and a ₹25 refund. An incorrectly treated refund produces ₹350; verified net sales are ₹300.

We'll cover:
• How a refund flips a dashboard number
• A better prompt: inspect → state assumptions → calculate → check → chart
• A simple independent arithmetic validation
• What Google actually says about the Gemini 4 Argon model and its ~1 million token unified context capacity
• The paid-access catch: Google AI Pro and Ultra in the app versus the separate paid developer API, with introductory pricing through November 30, 2026

IMPORTANT: All workflow screens, charts, data and outcomes are our original illustrative examples, NOT footage of Gemini 4 Argon producing a dashboard or evidence that the model made this exact mistake. Google's product claims are sourced to official announcements; we did not benchmark this model independently. Always verify important AI outputs with your own calculations. Narration is synthetic.
